results.title: Grok Bot vs n8n for outbound
results.content:
n8n can be self-hosted, so the cost is your infrastructure and time. Grok Bot comes in plans that include it and draws from a weekly usage pool. Different models, different jobs.

If you like building flows and want control over data, n8n. If you want to describe a job in plain language and read a list in the morning, Grok Bot. Both can call Omentir over MCP.

Prefer markdown?Grok Bot vs n8n for outbound.md

## Related articles [...] Pick the kind of maintenance your team will actually do. A team that never opens an editor will let n8n flows rot. A team that never reads the review list will let a Bot drift.

## Using both

A sensible split: n8n handles the plumbing (new booked call goes to the CRM, a weekly export goes to a sheet), and Grok Bot handles the overnight review and drafts. Omentir holds LinkedIn and the inbox in the middle. [...] Both can talk to Omentir instead. Omentir's MCP endpoint is  and there is a plain REST API for workflow tools that prefer HTTP calls. Either one can read leads, check stats and see the inbox, while Omentir sends with daily limits and send windows.

## When to pick n8n

 You want to see and version every step.
 Your data has to stay in your environment.
 The flow is the same every time and you want it fast and cheap.
 Someone on the team enjoys building and maintaining flows.
